subject: Mental Models
title: Symptoms vs Causes
description: A fast breakdown of Symptoms vs Causes for builders.

hook.text: A company losing customers added a loyalty program. Churn continued. The real problem was terrible customer service.

buildup.text: Symptoms are visible effects. Causes are hidden drivers. Treating the symptom feels productive but solves nothing.

discovery.text: Root cause analysis forces you past the symptom.

twist.text: Organizations love fixing symptoms because root causes often require painful structural changes that leaders resist.

climax.text: If a problem keeps returning despite fixes, you are treating a symptom. Go deeper until the fix sticks permanently.

punchline.text: If the problem returns, you only fixed the symptom.

quiz.question: How can you tell if you've only fixed a symptom?
options: The same problem keeps returning despite the fix
The team disagrees about the solution
